narrative.heading: Teaching and community mediation
narrative.text: On her UCSF Profiles page, Kanade Shinkai says she sees medical education as a mandate and privilege of academic medicine, and describes teaching and mentoring work at UCSF and through the American Academy of Dermatology. Her UCSF Medical Education profile also describes volunteer mediation in the UCSF community and communications coaching; she says she has developed communication and conflict-resolution curricula, including a workshop titled “Taking the difficult out of difficult conversations.” These sources document her stated commitment to teaching and community work, not patient outcomes.
